context: A teacher walks a teen through an English test preparation
purpose: Teach: 英文/解答/検定/検出/限度/欠点/ユニーク/多々

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今日は英文読解の練習から始めましょうか。
lines.en: Shall we start with English reading practice today?
lines.style: Calm teacher voice, gentle pacing, encouraging professional tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい…でも私、読むの遅いのが最大の欠点なんです。
lines.en: Yes... but reading slowly is my biggest weakness.
lines.style: Teen voice slightly sheepish, honest admission, soft tone

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 大丈夫、英検という検定はスピードより正確さが大事ですよ。
lines.en: It's fine, the Eiken test cares more about accuracy than speed.
lines.style: Reassuring teacher voice, warm and steady delivery

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: じゃあ解答用紙にこの答えを書いてみますね。
lines.en: Then I'll try writing this answer on the answer sheet.
lines.style: Teen voice gaining confidence, slightly determined intonation

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いい発想ですね。あなたの解釈はユニークで面白いです。
lines.en: Good thinking. Your interpretation is unique and interesting.
lines.style: Teacher voice warmly impressed, genuine praise, encouraging

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 本当ですか？でも間違いが多々ありそうで不安です。
lines.en: Really? But I'm worried there are probably many mistakes.
lines.style: Teen voice anxious but hopeful, soft uncertain delivery

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ミスの検出は私の仕事です。一緒に直しましょう。
lines.en: Spotting mistakes is my job. Let's fix them together.
lines.style: Teacher voice supportive and confident, professional warmth

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 集中力が限度に来る前に終わらせたいです。
lines.en: I want to finish before my focus reaches its limit.
lines.style: Teen voice determined, slightly tired but motivated tone

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: では時間を計りますね。ベルが鳴ったら鉛筆を置いてください。
lines.en: I'll time you then. Put your pencil down at the bell.
lines.style: Teacher voice professional, clear instruction, mildly firm
